text: Toronto Parking Authority's operating profit for the first quarter of 2022 is $1.1 million: $0.7 million better than plan. Operating revenues missed plan by $(3.1) million, however are $8.7 million higher than 2021. Bike Share operating losses for the first quarter of the year are $(1.5) million, +$0.1 million favourable versus our plan. Operating and administration expenses were lower by $3.6 million compared to budget as spending was adjusted to meet the requirements of the business. Despite unexpected Covid-19 restrictions during the first quarter, Toronto Parking Authority's full year operating profit is forecasted to be $15.1 million or $0.7 million favourable versus plan. Performance for the remainder of the year is expected to be on plan. As the pandemic continues to evolve.
